prompt: Review this plan before I approve it: shape next-quarter roadmap with three themes — shareable shortlist, push notifications, onboarding rewrite — allocated 60/30/10 across them. The shareable shortlist is highest priority because we keep getting requests. Push notifications because re-engagement is flat. Onboarding rewrite because the funnel is leaky. Approve?

assertions.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
